fullDescription: A sticky editorial serif navbar in cream, ink, and burgundy: a frosted translucent bar with a hairline rule, an upper/lower Fraunces wordmark, small-caps uppercase links with a grow-from-left underline, and an italic-serif burgundy 'Start designing' text CTA.
prompt:
## Resumo
A sticky editorial navbar in an off-white-cream, ink, and burgundy palette: a translucent backdrop-blurred bar that pins flush to the top with a hairline bottom rule, an upper/lower serif wordmark ('Faktur' + italic 'studio'), a row of small-caps uppercase nav links with a grow-from-left underline on hover, and a right cluster pairing a quiet uppercase 'Sign in' with an italic-serif burgundy 'Start designing' text CTA. Built on Fraunces (display serif) + Inter (UI sans) with a calm print-magazine feel, and it collapses below lg to an italic CTA plus a hamburger.

## Estilo Visual
Use an editorial cream + ink + burgundy design system on a soft cream page background #faf6ef with near-black ink text #1c1815 and one deep burgundy accent #7b2d3b (plus a lighter dusty-rose #d98a96 used only as an accent on dark sections). Two typefaces from Google Fonts: Fraunces (a fluid optical-size display serif, weights 300-900, used italic too) for the wordmark, headings, and italic CTA links; Inter (weights 400/500/600) for all UI/nav labels and body copy. Nav labels are tiny uppercase: 12px, font-medium (500), letter-spacing 0.18em; eyebrows go even tighter (0.28em) at 11px. The wordmark is Fraunces ~30px semibold tracking-tight, paired with a smaller Fraunces italic 'studio' tag in burgundy. Text colors use ink at opacities for hierarchy: headings/active solid ink, nav links text-ink/80, secondary text-ink/70, body text-ink/65. The bar is translucent: bg-cream at 85% (bg-cream/85) with backdrop-blur-md and a 1px bottom border of ink at 10% (border-ink/10). Add a barely-visible paper grain behind hero/dark sections via a radial-gradient dot (rgba(28,24,21,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px) on a 3px tile. Decorative dashed/dotted hairline rules use a repeating linear-gradient (rgba(28,24,21,0.16) 0 50%, transparent 50% 100%) at 8px x 1px. No drop shadows: hierarchy is carried by type scale, weight, italics, and hairline rules.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky translucent header
Wrap the navbar in a `<header class="sticky top-0 z-50 bg-cream/85 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-ink/10">` so it pins flush to the top of the viewport with a frosted cream fill and a 1px ink/10 hairline rule along its bottom edge as the page scrolls under it.

### Centered nav container + row
Inside the header, a `<nav class="mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 md:px-10">` holding a `<div class="flex h-16 md:h-[72px] items-center justify-between gap-6">` row. The 64px (md 72px) fixed height and the centered 1200px max-width must match the hero/feature/footer containers below so everything shares one column.

### Serif wordmark (left zone)
An anchor `flex items-baseline gap-2 shrink-0`: a Fraunces wordmark `font-serif text-[26px] md:text-[30px] leading-none font-semibold tracking-tight` reading 'Faktur', followed by a smaller Fraunces italic tag `hidden sm:inline-block font-serif italic text-[14px] md:text-[15px] text-burgundy` reading 'studio', nudged up 2px (translate-y-[-2px]) so it sits like a superscript imprint.

### Uppercase link group (center-right)
A `hidden lg:flex items-center gap-9 text-[12px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-ink/80 whitespace-nowrap` row of anchors (Library, Approach, Studio, Journal). Each link is `.nav-link` with `transition-colors hover:text-ink` and a grow-from-left underline: a `::after` 1px full-width bar in currentColor pinned 4px below, hidden via transform scaleX(0) with transform-origin left, animating to scaleX(1) on hover over .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1).

### Right actions cluster (Sign in + italic CTA)
A `hidden lg:flex items-center gap-7 whitespace-nowrap` group: a quiet ghost 'Sign in' link (`text-[12px] font-medium uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-ink/70 hover:text-ink transition-colors`), then the primary CTA rendered NOT as a button but as an italic-serif text link 'Start designing' (`.cta-link font-serif italic text-[17px] text-burgundy`) with a burgundy underline that retracts on hover (a `::after` 1px burgundy bar at full width that animates width to 0 on hover, the inverse of the nav-link underline).

### Mobile/tablet collapse (below lg)
A `flex lg:hidden items-center gap-5` group that replaces the center links and Sign in below lg: a compact italic-serif 'Start designing' burgundy CTA (`.cta-link font-serif italic text-[15px] md:text-[17px] text-burgundy whitespace-nowrap`) plus a 36x36 (h-9 w-9) ghost hamburger button (`grid place-items-center text-ink`, aria-label 'Open menu') holding a Phosphor list icon (ph:list, 22px) via Iconify.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Render the primary action as a Fraunces italic burgundy text link 'Start designing' rather than a filled button, with a burgundy 1px underline that RETRACTS (width animates to 0) on hover, so the call to action reads as an elegant editorial phrase, not a UI control. Reserve the one filled pill button for the hero/CTA band, not the navbar.

### Componente
Use two complementary 1px underline animations driven by ::after pseudo-elements: nav links grow an underline from the left (transform scaleX 0 to 1, origin left) on hover, while the burgundy CTA link's underline retracts (width 100% to 0) on hover, giving opposite, intentional motion between the navigation and the action.

### Componente
Brand mark is a two-part Fraunces lockup: an upright semibold tracking-tight wordmark 'Faktur' baseline-aligned with a smaller italic burgundy 'studio' tag nudged up ~2px, so the logo reads like a magazine masthead rather than an icon + label.

### Componente
The bar is a translucent `bg-cream/85` with `backdrop-blur-md` and only a single 1px `border-ink/10` bottom rule (no shadow), so it sits as a quiet frosted sheet of the same paper color over the scrolling content, separated by a hairline.

## Notas Especiais
Icons are Phosphor via Iconify (ph:list for the mobile menu; the hero/CTA band also use ph:arrow-up-right and ph:arrow-right). Fonts: Fraunces (display serif, also italic) for the wordmark, headings, and italic CTA links; Inter for all uppercase nav labels and body. Exact tokens: cream #faf6ef (page + bar fill at 85%), ink #1c1815 (text, used at /80 /70 /65 /10 /12 opacities), burgundy #7b2d3b (accent + CTA), dusty-rose #d98a96 (accent word on the dark CTA band only). The bar pins flush (sticky top-0) with a 1px ink/10 bottom rule and backdrop-blur, no shadow. Legibility fixes applied vs the source editorial reference: nav labels stay at full ink/80 (not faded) and the active hover state bumps to solid ink; the burgundy accent #7b2d3b clears AA contrast on cream for the CTA text; type hierarchy is carried by the Fraunces/Inter pairing, the uppercase 0.18em tracking, and hairline rules so nothing relies on color alone. Layout is responsive: the centered uppercase link group and Sign in collapse below lg, leaving a compact italic CTA + a hamburger; the 'studio' tag hides below sm.
